The formula $\fn{Count}(X) \ident $
\begin{multline*}
\lexists[z][\lexists[u][(X(z) \land 
    \lforall[x][(X(x) \lif X(u(x)))] \land {} \\ \lforall[Y][((Y(z) \land
      \lforall[x][(Y(x) \lif Y(u(x)))]) \lif X = Y])]])
\end{multline*}
is satisfied with respect to a variable assignment~$s$ iff $s(X)$ is
!!{enumerable}.
